s.note: Hot chips with rich brown gravy and melted mozzarella
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for about 30 minutes until crisp. Meanwhile soften 1 small finely diced onion in 40g butter for 6 minutes, stir in 30g plain flour and cook until nut brown, then whisk in 500ml beef stock, 1 tsp soy sauce and 0.5 tsp black pepper and simmer for 8 minutes until smooth and thick. Pile the chips in a dish, scatter with 200g grated mozzarella and ladle the hot gravy over so the cheese melts.

s.note: Charred sweetcorn with chilli lime butter, parmesan and coriander
s.how: Mash 60g soft butter with the zest and juice of 1 lime, 0.5 tsp chilli powder, 0.5 tsp smoked paprika and 0.5 tsp salt. Boil 4 husked corn cobs, halved, for 4 minutes, then char on a very hot grill or barbecue for 10 minutes, turning. Brush with the butter and roll in 30g finely grated parmesan and 2 tbsp chopped coriander.

m.note: Beef mince in a sweet and tangy tomato sauce with onion and capsicum, on toasted soft rolls with pickles
m.how: Brown 750g beef mince in 1 tbsp vegetable oil, breaking it up. Add 1 diced onion, 1 diced green capsicum and 2 crushed garlic cloves and cook for 6 minutes. Stir in 125ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 250ml water, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Toast 4 soft burger buns in 20g butter, pile in the filling and top with sliced dill pickles.

w.note: Blueberries baked under a buttery buttermilk biscuit crust, with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Heat the oven to 190C. Toss 750g blueberries with 100g caster sugar, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp cornflour in a 25cm ovenproof pan. Rub 90g cold cubed butter into 200g self-raising flour, 50g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, then stir in 160ml buttermilk to a soft dough. Dollop over the fruit, sprinkle with 1 tbsp demerara sugar and bake for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 10 minutes and serve with 500ml vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Cold lager topped with homemade lemonade, with lemon slices
d.how: Stir 80g caster sugar into 80ml hot water until dissolved and cool, then mix with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml chilled soda water to make the lemonade. Half fill 4 chilled glasses with 750ml cold lager, top with the lemonade and add a slice of lemon.
